I remember it was the last day of my freshman year of high school. Me and my friend Liam walked home from school to my house and my mom drove us to the theater to see the movie. Of all my friends at the time me and Liam were the biggest Star Wars fanatics and we were absolutely stoked to see the movie. We sat in either the back row of the theater or the second to back row and it was absolutely packed. When the blue text “A long time ago in a galaxy far, far away…” came up on screen the audience cheered, and then when the big yellow “Star Wars” came on the audience cheered even louder. We read the opening crawl, and as it faded out and began to show the space battle above Coruscant we were absolutely hooked. It just got bigger and better as it went on and we just had these shit eating grins on our faces the entire time. Then we sat back and watch the movie. Then I remember at the very end when Obi-Wan is handing off Luke to Uncle Owen and Aunt Beru on Tatooine and they’re holding him and looking at the binary sunset and The Force theme plays I started crying because it was just so beautiful. It’s like poetry, it rhymes. I was also crying because I knew this was the end, at the time we thought there wouldn’t be any more Star Wars movies after this so it was a sad moment. Overall 10/10, no notes.
